title: parashorea buchananii
intro: Parashorea buchananii, commonly known as the Bukitan Timah tree, is a species of plant in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This tropical tree is known for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which help in reducing pain and swelling, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Parashorea buchananii include its ability to act as an analgesic, antipyretic, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for various diseases and conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit significant biological activities.
